CAN TX Frame Builder.
Signature: display_render_lok_screen(D=cmd, SP[0]=data_param, SP[2]=ctx_ptr, SP[4]=size)

Builds 29-bit CAN extended ID from cmd and data_param:
  id_hi = (cmd & 0x1C00) | (data_param >> 6)
  id_lo = (cmd & 0x03FF) | ((data_param & 0x3F) << 10)
  29-bit CAN ID = id_hi[12:0]:id_lo[15:0]

For cmd=0x1C7E (registration):
  29-bit ID = 0b111 << 26 | data_param << 10 | 0x7E
  Prio=7(0b111), data_param field in bits[25:10], Node=126(0x7E)

cmd bit field mapping:
  cmd[12:10] = Priority (3 bits) -> CAN ID[28:26]
  cmd[9:0]   = Node address (10 bits) -> CAN ID[9:0]
  data_param (16 bits) -> CAN ID[25:10]

Calls can_tx_enqueue_frame(D=id_lo, X=id_hi, ctx_ptr, size) where size=DLC.

32-bit left shift: D:X = data_param << 10 (D=low, X=high in lsl32_dxy convention).
Result stored: SP[0:1]=X(high_word), SP[2:3]=D(low_word) = big-endian 32-bit at SP[0:3].

Per CAN_Doku chapter 6: Communication Phases

CAN ID during registration (mcan_registration_id_t):
  Bits 28-26: Priority (0b111)
  Bits 25-16: UID byte (10 bits, one per stage)
  Bits 15-13: Stage (0-7)
  Bits 12-8:  MID (assigned by master, 0-31)
  Bit 7:      Direction (0=slave, 1=master)
  Bits 6-0:   Node number (126=registration, 127=flash)

CAN ID after registration (mcan_operational_id_t):
  Bits 28-26: Priority (0b111)
  Bits 25-10: Object Handle (16-bit, from start_handle)
  Bits 9-7:   Command (3 bits)
  Bits 6-0:   Node number (assigned by master)

Registration stages:
  Stage 0: Slave sends UID[3], master responds with own UID
           Data: mcan_reg_stage0_master_t
  Stage 1: Slave sends UID[2], master responds with vendor ID
           Data: mcan_reg_stage1_master_t (vendor_id=0x97=ESU)
  Stage 2: Slave sends UID[1], master responds with HW version
           Data: mcan_reg_stage2_master_t
  Stage 3: Slave sends UID[0], master responds with SW version

p3d_signal_generator: Maerklin Motorola track signal generator.
Generates timing for Motorola format track protocol.

Reads ADC channels:
  ATD0DR3H: current sense channel A
  ATD0DR4H: current sense channel B

Computes signal timing using:
  EMUL (16x16 unsigned multiply)
  IDIVS (signed integer divide)

Timing variables:
  word_10F2 (signal_period): computed period
  word_10F4 (signal_offset): zero-crossing offset
  word_10F6 (signal_timing_a): timing counter A
  word_10F8 (signal_timing_b): timing counter B

M-CAN speed encoding:
  0x00-0x7F = forward (127 speed steps)
  0x80-0xFF = reverse

Manages system_status_flags and lokstack_function_flags
for track power state coordination.

Countdown expiry: inc counter at 0x13C9, reset to 60000, CONTINUES (does not return).
operating_mode==0: reads ADC ch4, sets signal_period, returns.
lokstack_function_flags==0: just returns.
status&3==2: optionally inc counter at 0x13CD, reloads status, FALLS THROUGH.

comments.regular: LBMI: if diff<0, branch to load signal_timing_a for subtraction (IDA had misanalyzed as fcb $18 + bmi)
LBEQ: if diff==0, same target as LBMI above
Post-timing check: if both timing_a and timing_b are 0, additional processing follows (word_13A4 threshold checks, system_status_flags/can_master_status updates)
signal_timing_b subtraction: D = signal_timing_b - timing_diff, store back
signal_timing_a subtraction: Y = signal_timing_a - diff, store back
period<0: clear signal_period to 0, continue to min_period calc (does NOT return)
status&3==2: check signal_gen_mode&2, optionally inc counter at 0x13CD, reload status, fall through to main signal gen
operating_mode==0: read ADC ch4 * byte_FF68, set signal_period, then return
countdown==0: inc 24-bit counter at 0x13C9, reset countdown to 60000, fall through to operating_mode check
Power manager: PB3 (ANDB #8) = STOP/GO toggle. Toggles system_status_flags bit 0. Long-press (button_code >= 0x2E) triggers power-off.

p3d_lok_main_handler: Main lok handling routine.
Largest function in FLASH_3D (~3.5KB).
Manages lok display, CAN communication, speed/function commands,
and lok database access. Reads button/encoder state from byte_13B0/13B1.

comments.regular: LOK HANDLER DISPATCH: After track_voltage_ramp reaches 30, disables timer CH4 interrupt and output compare, then erases EEPROM at 0x800 (factory reset of lok config) and reinitializes hardware.
EEPROM FACTORY RESET: Erases sector at EEPROM_BASE (0x800), effectively clearing the language/config byte. This triggers fresh EEPROM init on next boot (language<=3 check at 0xD39E).

Phase 3 verified: 7 bugs fixed in C — (1) button_state_mask renamed to button_state_edge, (2) when addr mismatch+no button, asm exits (C fell through), (3) lokdb_entry_accessor params swapped: LOK/OK=3 Menu/ESC=2, (4) match_flags bit 0 SET goes to button check (was inverted), (5) nibble==8 has full encoder handler (was simple continue), (6) directional funcs SET/CLEAR bits (was TOGGLE), (7) post-loop re-checks buttons. Uses CALLER stack frame.

p3d_lok_handler_speed_update: Function key loop tail. ORs mask bits into func_update_mask at [X], checks loop counter (arg_14). If zero → display_update. If non-zero → loop back via Y+3 (func_bits). Internal block of state machine function key loop. Verified 2026-03-23.

p3d_lok_handler_display_update: Lok DB browsing handler (203B). Multiple paths: 0x3D99B4=func key clear-mask (leax 3,y → loop), 0x3D99B8=direction check, 0x3D99CB=EEPROM load+buttons, 0x3D9A0F=LOK/OK activate DB entry, 0x3D9A31=lokstack_search, 0x3D9A41=lok_db_save_pending state machine. Verified 2026-03-23.

p3d_lok_handler_function_toggle: Mode check (2-4) + LOK/OK button dispatch. addb #$FE + cmpb #2 validates mode 2-4. Checks edge&raw bit 0. If pressed → p3d_lok_handler_menu_dispatch. Verified 2026-03-23.
Menu dispatch: ESC/HL → inc page_saved, dispatch. No button → LOK/OK handler at 0x3D9BF7
page_saved=1: setup menu params. current_entry=3, word_10B2=1, word_10B6=3, word_10B4=3, ps=3
page_saved=5: byte_17F6==0xFF → full config setup, else delay+dispatch(1)
page_saved=3: format '%d' to 0x1797, setup 0x17A7-17BA, loop 0x17BB stride 3, render_text(10)
page_saved=4: EEPROM param cycle via eeprom_load_lok_params
LOK/OK entry (no index_check): load page_saved, dispatch at 0x3D9C14
LOK/OK entry (with index_check first): index_check, then page_saved dispatch
LOK/OK ps=1: init editing. banked_call count, EEPROM load, copy to name buf
LOK/OK ps=2: byte_10BE>=0 → save_dispatch(1), <0 → copy name data from 0x10BF+offset
byte_17F6 dispatch: 0xFF→full config setup, 0→delay+dispatch, else exit
Full config setup: parse byte_10BC/BD, set 0x17A7-BA, copy func keys, render_text(10)
Language save: language_index = page_saved-1, lok_db_pending_flags |= 0x20, dispatch(1)
SECRET COMBOS: porta==0x11 → factory reset, porta==0x88 → watchdog reset
FACTORY RESET: disable IRQs, erase 0xBE0, program node_id+1, clear 0xBE2, sub_403C reboot
EEPROM ERASE: disable IRQs, erase sector 0x800, sub_403C reboot

p3d_lok_handler_param_read: Display entry address check (44B). Gets display entry for slot, checks direction&0x7F. If zero: compares display addr to current_lok_address. Match → config edit. Mismatch → p3d_lok_db_index_check + delay_seconds(0x3E, 4). Verified 2026-03-23.
Config edit button handler: LOK/OK→index_check, ESC/HL→clear flags+mark entry+save_dispatch(1)
Config state machine entry: load slot+page_saved, check addr match, jump table 0xEA6E on config_state
Jump table dispatch: arg_1C=config_state (0-8), table at 0xEA6E
Case 1: param editing. Check direction&0x7F, sub-dispatch on page_saved (1/2/3/4)
page_saved=1: lok_db_current_entry = entry[slot].function_icons, word_10B2=0, advance to 2
page_saved=2: EEPROM load with proto param table at 0xEC2F (4B/proto)
ESC/HL after EEPROM: proto 2→ps=3, proto 3+bit4→ps=3, else ps=4
page_saved=4: writeback function_icons to entry, set disp flags, save_dispatch(1)
page_saved=3: button confirm. Any of LOK/ESC/HL → advance ps=4. Not LOK/OK → word_10B2=1
Case 2: name editor. Cycle char via charset table 0xF305 (75 entries)
Headlight: advance cursor (++current_entry, max 13), fill empty with 'A'
ESC: strip leading spaces, trim trailing, copy name buf to entry, save_dispatch(1)
Strip leading spaces: shift string left by 1, repeat until non-space

p3d_lok_handler_eeprom_save: Button debounce + EEPROM save (40B). Checks button_state_raw bit 0, then pb0_debounce_count <= 0x27, then edge&raw bit 0. Three-way dispatch: no button → return, debounce expired → slot_activate_load, button within window → slot_activate. Verified 2026-03-23.

p3d_lok_handler_slot_activate: Slot activation (105B). Decrements lok_db_current_entry, checks -1. Entry 0x3DA48D=index_check only. Entry 0x3DA493=EEPROM load (mode 0x0D) + button check (ESC/headlight #$12, LOK/OK #1). Verified 2026-03-23.
p3d_can_lok_sync_handler: eeprom_load(lok_db_current_entry,5) with 0x40. Button check 0x12/0x01. Verified 2026-03-24.

p3d_main_task_loop: init then cooperative main loop. Calls hw_peripheral_setup, p3d_signal_generator, p3d_encoder_sample_dispatch each iteration. Protocol state dispatch: 0=p3d_can_ppage_setup, 1=signal_gen_cmd_buf_consumer(8), 2=main_task_scheduler, 3=extended_protocol_dispatch(jump table 0xEAFD)
Common tail: p3d_encoder_sample_dispatch + wait_for_next_ms_tick + loop back to full loop (B9D9)
Case 3: extended protocol dispatch. Extracts bits 2-4 of protocol_state_word (mask 0x1C), jump table at 0xEAFD
Case 2: main_task_scheduler(). Falls through to common tail at BA01
Lokstack active path: signal_gen_send_buf_executor(8), then skip to protocol check (B9E7)
RENAMED from lokdb_search_by_address. Actual: HW timer/ADC init. Sets TSCR1=$90, clears TCTL3/TIE bits.

ATD0 INIT: CTL2=0xC0 (power up, fast flag clear), CTL3=0x00 (8 conversions), CTL4=0x6C (4-clock sample, prescaler 12), CTL5=0x30 (continuous multi-channel scan AN0-AN7). PUCR bit0=PORTA pull-ups, bit1=PORTB pull-ups.

p3d_hw_set_timer_params: Sets timer interval parameters.
Input: B = min value, arg_1 = timer count, arg_3 = mode
Disables interrupts during update (ORCC #$50).

REPL FIX: p3d_encoder_sample_dispatch now calls p3d_encoder_state_machine(). Previously was a no-op stub. Also fixed A channel sampling: was unconditional incb, now conditional on PTT.6 (brset PTT,#$40).

Rotary encoder quadrature state machine. Reads PTT.7, uses encoder_a_debounce and encoder_b_debounce for debouncing. Tracks direction via encoder_direction_state. Jump table at 0xBAFE dispatches CW/CCW rotation events.

Encoder quadrature dispatch jump table (16 entries).
Index = (encoder_direction_state * 4) + current_quadrature_state
Targets:
  0xBB5F = no rotation (same state)
  0xBB1E = clockwise rotation handler
  0xBB1F = counter-clockwise rotation handler
After entry 15: code for encoder handlers follows.

Encoder clockwise rotation handler.
Called from dispatch table when CW rotation detected.
Updates word_10FF/10FD (encoder position).

Encoder counter-clockwise rotation handler.
Called from dispatch table when CCW rotation detected.
Decrements encoder position, with bounds checking.

p3d_strlen: Returns length of null-terminated string.
Input: D = pointer to string
Output: D = string length
Returns 0 if pointer is NULL.

p3d_strcmp: Lexicographic comparison of two strings.
Input: D = string1 ptr, arg_0 = string2 ptr
Output: var_3 = -1/0/1 comparison result

p3d_strncpy: Bounded string copy with null termination.
Input: D = src ptr, arg_0 = dst ptr, arg_2 = max length
Output: D = pointer past last copied byte

p3d_str_append_char: Appends a single character to string.
Input: D = string ptr, arg_1 = character to append
Output: D = updated string pointer
Finds end of string, writes char, adds null terminator.

p3d_itoa: Integer to ASCII conversion with formatting.
Input: var_E = value, arg_4 = field width, arg_3 = base (2-35), arg_7 = fill char
Output: formatted number string on stack
Supports sign handling, zero-padding, field width.

p3d_sprintf: Mini sprintf implementation.
Input: D = output buffer ptr, arg_0 = format string ptr, arg_2+ = varargs
Output: D = updated output pointer
Scans format string for '%' specifiers, calls p3d_itoa for conversions.
